exposure: Mode of conception (infertility without fertility treatment, ovulation induction or intrauterine insemination, in vitro fertilization or intracytoplasmic sperm injection, unassisted conception)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies in Ontario, Canada, between October 2006 and February 2014 (19,099 with endometriosis, 768,350 without)
finding: Endometriosis was independently associated with an increased risk of various adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth, placental disorders, cesarean delivery, and stillbirth.
mod_finding: Endometriosis was directly associated with most adverse outcomes, except for stillbirth where infertility and fertility treatment played a mediating role.
